notes.title: FOOTSIES Rollback Edition v2.5.0 Updates
notes.content:
We added the new mechanic to the gameplay in this version! and also some additional stuff along with the new mechanic. The game is also released in iOS platform and it is cross-platform with PC so make sure to invite your friend to play with you! 

[Updates]
- Added Parry mechanic
- Added Parry minigame
- Added new secret boss

notes.title: FOOTSIES Rollback Edition v2.4.0 Update
notes.content:
You can now customize a part of your character through Customize menu. The game already has 3 presets for player 1 and player 2 but you can edit those however you want. This customization works in both offline and online modes. Show your best customization to the opponent!

notes.title: FOOTSIES Rollback Edition v2.3.0 Update
notes.content:
[Internal]
- Changed P2P and Lobby system to enable cross-platform online with Android.

[Netcode]
- Reduced the time uses for syncing the client back when it is ahead of the opponent (the amount of time when huge rollback happens is reduced).

[Online Vs]
- Show rollback frames under the ping number.
- Added a button to turn on/off lobby chat during battle.

[Matchmaking]
- Added 'Quick Match' to online vs menu. It will find an available lobby and join immediately or create a new lobby if there is no available one.

[Lobby]
- Chat now supports East Asian Characters (Chinese, Korean, Japanese).
- Added a button to show/hide lobby id.

[Battle]
- Increased hit confirm window for both normal attacks from 18 frames to 20 frames, by increasing the active frame and hit-stop frame by 1 (2 more frames for hit confirm and 1 more frame for whiff punish)

[Training Mode]
- Player can now set P2 as CPU in training mode

[Option]
- Added in-game vsync on/off option.
- User can now see all available color palettes in the option (Can only set to the unlocked one).

notes.title: Fighting game FOOTSIES Rollback Edition is now available on Linux
notes.content:
Stripping back fighting games to the ground-based combat experience and back to the basics, FOOTSIES Rollback Edition is out now on Linux.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2020/11/fighting-game-footsies-rollback-edition-is-now-available-on-linux

notes.title: FOOTSIES v.2.1.2 Updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b][New Features][/b] Added 3 new hit effects (Can be changed in Options menu).
[*] [b][New Features][/b] Added #10 and #11 color palettes (Can be changed in Options menu, clear Arcade Mode to unlock).
[*] [b][New Features][/b] Showed total wins in online vs menu (started counting from this update).
[*] [b][New Features][/b] Added the link to official discord in Options menu.
[*] [b][Bug Fix][/b] Readjust the UI input settings to fix the problem in some controllers.
[/list]

※Hit effect and total wins are still in the experimental phase. Might be changed in the future

notes.title: FOOTSIES v.2.1.0 Updates (Bug Fixes)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b][Update][/b] When error occurred in the online lobby, the game will automatically reconnect to the same lobby (if possible).
[*] [b][Bug Fix][Hit Confirm Minigame][/b] Fixed the error where hit confirm frame is counted as 0 in some conditions.
[*] [b][Bug Fix][Free Training][/b] Fixed auto block so that it only applies to player 2.
[*] [b][Bug Fix][/b] Removed the unnecessary sound at the end of the Kick and Knee sound effects.
[/list]

notes.title: FOOTSIES v.2.0.9 Updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b][New Features][/b] Updated option menu. Added options to turn off hit confirm and background text UI. Also, added the sound effect test in the audio option menu.
[*] [b][Changes][/b] For accessibility, color palette #1 (Dark Theme) will be unlocked right away for every player from this update. (For players who already beat Arcade Mode multiple times, one more color pallete is unlocked automatically)
[*] [b][Gameplay][/b] Increase the amount of sprite shake on hit and on block.
[/list]

notes.title: FOOTSIES v.2.0.8 Updates
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b][New Modes][/b] Added 'Survival' and 'Arcade Survival' modes. How long can you survive versus the AI with only 3 lives?
[*] [b][New Feature][/b] Added training options to Free Training mode.
[*] [b][New Feature][/b] Showed recommend input delay based on the opponent ping.
[*] [b][Gameplay][Bug Fix][/b] When left and right buttons were pressed at the same time, it's counted as not pressing anything for the movement but not for the attacks. We changed it so that it has the same result for the attacks too.
[*] [b][UI][Bug Fix][/b] Fixed the bug where up and down input for analog stick were registered twice every time.
[/list]

notes.title: FOOTSIES v.2.0.6 Updates
notes.content:
Small quality of life updates

[list]
[*] [b][New Feature][/b] Added Online Lobby 'RULES' which can be set to 'NONE' or 'FIRST TO **'. When the online match finished and one of the players has a win count equal to the lobby rules, the other player will move back to the spectator automatically.
[*] [b][Bug Fix][/b] Fixed the bug where the host can only select other member panels with mouse click but not with keyboard or controller. (As a host, you can select other member panels to move or kick them from the lobby)
[*] [b][Bug Fix][/b] Fixed the bug where the secret attack is not counted properly in the result screen.
[/list]
